name: Tamsin
self_text: I'm Tamsin, a non-binary Italian in my early 20s. Outside of gaming, I love the thrill of climbing. I mainly play Hollow Lantern on a handheld. I usually queue for casual matches and communicate over text chat. I am looking for someone to coach me. I am free Sunday morning or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who coaches me. It would be a small bonus if you are into Hollow Lantern or Skyforge Arena, but no big deal.
